description: §66.19.1 counter with `persist="local" key=` on `@count`: compiles clean; with no stored value the cell starts at its default and counts / resets exactly as the unpersisted counter (+, +, Reset, + → 1).
rationale: §6.14.2 rule 3: "If the key is absent, storage is unavailable, the decode fails, or the decoded value does not satisfy the contract, the cell SHALL take its default"; rule 4: "When the cell's value changes, the compiler-emitted code SHALL encode the new value and write it to storage"; rule 9: "`reset(@x)` on a persisted cell … SHALL write the reset value to the cell". §6.14.1 rule 3: "`persist=` is legal on client-owned state cells."
